SM-1
CONSIDERATION OF A PURCHASE ORDER CONTRACT WITH CALPIPE INDUSTRIES, LLC FOR THE PURCHASE OF 72 REMOVABLE BOLLARDS FOR ROAD CLOSURES IN THE AMOUNT OF $68,582.78
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the purchase order contract with Calpipe Industries, LLC for the purchase of 72 removable bollards; (2) authorize the City Manager to execute, on behalf of the City, all documents necessary to effectuate this action.

A.

A-1 Minutes 10-8-19 CC SA
A-1 Minutes 10-8-19 CC Town Hall
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF: (1) A RESOLUTION ADOPTING AN INITIAL STUDY AND MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION, A MITIGATION MONITORING AND REPORTING PROGRAM, AND AN ERRATA, FOR MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT NUMBER 146 AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT APPLICATION NUMBER 17-02; (2) AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 10.34.170 (ELECTRONIC DISPLAY BILLBOARDS) OF CHAPTER 10.34 (SIGNS) OF TITLE 10 (ZONING) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ADDRESS OPERATIONAL STANDARDS FOR ELECTRONIC DISPLAY BILLBOARDS IN THE CITY; (3) AN ORDINANCE APPROVING DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT NO. 17-02 TO CONSTRUCT, INSTALL AND OPERATE THREE ELECTRONIC DISPLAY BILLBOARDS ON CITY-OWNED PROPERTIES AND TO CONSTRUCT AND INSTALL AN ELECTRONIC PARK SIGN AT LA PUENTE PARK FOR USE AND OPERATION BY THE CITY; AND (4) A LICENSE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND BULLETIN DISPLAYS, LLC
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and take public testimony; (2) adopt Resolution No. 19-5521 making findings and adopting an Initial Study and Mitigated Negative Declaration with Mitigation and Monitoring Reporting Program with an Errata for Municipal Code Amendment Number 146 and Development Agreement Application Number 17-02; (3) waive reading of Ordinance No. 19-964 and read by title only; (4) introduce Ordinance No. 19-964, an Ordinance of the City of La Puente, California, Amending Section 10.34.170 (Electronic Display Billboards) of Chapter 10.34 (Signs) of Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code to Address Operational Standards For Electronic Display Billboards in the City; (5) waive reading of Ordinance No. 19-965 and read by title only;
(6) introduce Ordinance No. 19-965, an Ordinance of the City of La Puente, California, Approving Development Agreement No. 17-02 to Allow the Construction, Installation and Operation of Three Electronic Display Billboards on City-Owned Properties and to Allow the Construction and Installation of an Electronic Park Sign at La Puente Park for use and Operation by the City; and (7) approve the License Agreement between the City and Bulletin Displays, LLC.

C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL – None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1481
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 19-5520 approving Warrant Register No. 1481.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1481
D-2
PRESENTATION OF SEPTEMBER 2019 INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-2 September Investment Report Staff Report
D-2 September Investment Report Attachments A-E
D-3
PRESENTATION OF SEPTEMBER 2019 REQUISITION SUMMARY REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-3 September Requisition Report Staff Report
D-3 September Requisition Report Attachment A Report
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR VALLEY BOULEVARD SANITARY SEWER REHABILITATION FY 19-20 PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the plans and specifications for the construction of the Valley Boulevard Sanitary Sewer Rehabilitation FY 19-20 Project; and (2) authorize Staff to solicit for bids.
D-4 Bid Valley Sewer and Pavement Repairs Staff Report
D-5
SECOND READING OF AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND TABLE 2-5 (CM ZONE-ALLOWED USES AND PERMIT REQUIREMENTS) OF SECTION 10.14.020 (LAND USE REGULATIONS) OF CHAPTER 10.14 (COMMERCIAL-MANUFACTURING ZONE) OF ARTICLE 2 (ZONES, ALLOWABLE USES AND DEVELOPMENT AND DESIGN STANDARDS) OF TITLE 10 (ZONING) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ALLOW BANQUET FACILITY USES IN THE COMMERCIAL MANUFACTURING ZONE SUBJECT TO APPROVAL OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT, ADOPT ASSOCIATED MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENTS TO ACCOMMODATE SAID USE, AND ADOPT A NEGATIVE DECLARATION REGARDING SAME
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No. 19-963, an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente amending Table 2-5 (CM Zone-allowed Uses and Permit Requirements) of Section 10.14.020 (Land Use Regulations) of Chapter 10.14 (Commercial-Manufacturing Zone) of Article 2 (Zones, Allowable Uses and Development and Design Standards) of Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code to allow banquet facility uses in the Commercial Manufacturing zone subject to approval of a Conditional Use Permit, adopt associated municipal code amendments to accommodate said use, and adopt the IS/ND regarding same.
D-5 MCA 145 Banquet Facilities Staff Report
D-5 MCA 145 Banquet Facilities Attachment A Ordinance
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A GRANT AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE BOARD OF STATE AND COMMUNITY CORRECTIONS AND THE CITY OF LA PUENTE FOR THE YOUTH REINVESTMENT GRANT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Grant Agreement No. BSCC 573-19 between the Board of State and Community Corrections and the City of La Puente for the funding of the Adolescent Intervention and Diversion (AID) program; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-6 Youth Reinvestment Grant Staff Report
D-6 Youth Reinvestment Grant Attachment A Agreement

CONSIDERATION OF A FACILITY USE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AND THE LA PUENTE VALLEY WOMAN’S CLUB FOR USE OF THE FRONT LAWN AT CITY HALL FOR THE LA PUENTE READING INVASION
taff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Use Agreement between the City of La Puente and the La Puente Valley Woman’s Club; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.

AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
